kxng wooz.bio: Kxng Wooz is a Halifax-based Canadian hip-hop artist whose music pairs introspective lyricism with contemporary rap production. A longtime part of Nova Scotia's independent scene, he has released projects including Entering The..., Redemption and MALIK and collaborated with artists such as Ghettosocks, Aquakultre, Timbuktu and Leila Dey.

mikezup.bio: MikeZup is a Montreal-area rapper, songwriter and producer whose career grew out of Quebec's francophone street-rap scene. Active since his teens, the Laval artist built an independent catalogue around projects including the Omerta trilogy, Imprévu and Couleurs Primaires before continuing through his own 630MG label.

gnino.bio: Gnino is a Montreal rapper from Tétreaultville in the city's east end who grew up immersed in Quebec hip-hop through his father, rapper Rjboy. After beginning to write in his teens, he built momentum through the Cagoulé Gang duo and solo releases including Paranoia, developing a melodic, emotionally direct style within Montreal's francophone rap scene.

cupidon.bio: Cupidon is a Montreal street rapper from the city's Sud-Ouest who has been active in Quebec hip-hop since the early 2010s. His catalogue includes solo releases and collaborations with artists including Lebza Khey and DawaMafia, with a direct writing style rooted in the local rap québécois scene.
